acceptanceCriteria: shellcheck is clean on examples/cem and every file under examples/** carries its Apache-2.0 SPDX header.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Reviews of PR #75 and #81: SC1007 in verify-pr.sh; the files added by #75 under examples/cem have no SPDX header although LICENSING.md places examples/** under Apache-2.0.
title: examples/cem: `verify-pr.sh` shellcheck SC1007 and missing SPDX headers on the #75 example files
